design.intent: 让低频率状态确认拥有可定位的短起点。
design.use_when: 在状态已经真实提交时少量使用；不是每次 hover 或每个字都响。
design.avoid_when: 高频重复操作、需要无障碍静音或错误警报。
design.mix_notes: 起音与确认帧对齐；响度在实际全混音中再定。

source.creator: MotionStudio contributors
source.provenance: Original procedural source; no external recording, samples or reference melody.

rights.conditions: Retain the MIT copyright and permission notice with the source and generated asset redistribution. No trademark, voice or endorsement rights implied.
rights.basis: Original source and synthesis without third-party samples.

review.limits: Technical checks are per-output receipts. No listening, pleasantness, reference-match or film acceptance is asserted.
